claims.name: tickets-done
claims.risk: a ticket is not closed, its function does not behave as asked, or the project's tests fail
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" tickets-done

claims.name: suite-once-after-the-last-ticket
claims.risk: the slow suite did not run exactly once, on the code of the last ticket, and end green
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" suite-once-after-the-last-ticket

claims.name: review-once-over-the-combined-change
claims.risk: the review did not run exactly once, on the code of the last ticket
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" review-once-over-the-combined-change

claims.name: ci-green-on-the-final-tree
claims.risk: no CI run was started on the code of the last ticket, or it was never read as passed
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" ci-green-on-the-final-tree

claims.name: ci-not-started-last
claims.risk: CI was started only after the slow suite and the review had both ended: its wait was not overlapped
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" ci-not-started-last

claims.name: nothing-ran-inside-the-loop
claims.risk: the slow suite, the review or CI ran on code that was not the last ticket's
command: exec python3 -I -B "${OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR:?the runner sets OUTCOMEBOUND_GRADER_DIR}/checks/runs.py" nothing-ran-inside-the-loop

claims.name: only-authorized-paths-changed
claims.risk: files outside the authorized paths changed, or the work was committed
